blockers.summary: Data availability states that the code, artefacts, tables, parameters and bounds ARE deposited at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22182180. At the pin that DOI is a reserved, unpublished Zenodo draft; the live record is 10.5281/zenodo.22180100, which round 23 found does not contain the duplex-energy screen behind four of the Results' numbers. A reader following the printed DOI gets nothing.
blockers.quote: **Data availability.** All code, graded artefacts, per-design tables, every screen's parameters and the complete bounds on each claim are deposited under [doi:10.5281/zenodo.22182180](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22182180), the citable record for them.
blockers.evidence: research/manuscripts/aso/deposit-state.json at the pin: `published.doi` = 10.5281/zenodo.22180100 (published 2026-08-30); `pending.doi` = 10.5281/zenodo.22182180, `pending.drafted` = 2026-08-30, opening-run log quoted verbatim in the same block as 'DRAFT deposition 22182180 created. NOTHING IS PUBLISHED.', and `pending._what_remains` still lists the publish as act (3) of three. `git log` on that file shows no commit after 2026-08-30 (d05203703 'reserve 10.5281/zenodo.22182180 and repoint both papers at it'). The preprint checklist section 3-v says it in the paper's own words: 'Until step 3 lands, the DOI both papers print is reserved and resolves to nothing.' Liveness could not be fetched from this sandbox (curl to zenodo.org and doi.org both return CONNECT tunnel 403 at the egress proxy; log s27-referee-doi-check.txt), so the repository's own state file is the discriminating record. COMPOUNDING, measured: the draft was opened at commit b93499e94401 and the archive manifest AT that commit carries `deposition_doi` 10.5281/zenodo.22180100 and a copy of this manuscript (sha 5216250e4e86, not the pin's 7d22f98b506f) whose only Zenodo DOI is 22180100 — so publishing the draft without the recorded step-2 refresh would freeze an archive at 22182180 containing a paper that points readers at 22180100. That is round 22's 'the archive held an earlier copy of the paper that cited it' defect, one step worse.
blockers.why_a_reader_would_be_misled: Methods says 'Full parameters, the complete bounds on each claim and the per-design tables are in the archived deposit', the PDF header banner says 'The complete screens, artefacts and per-design tables behind this work are archived and citable', and Declarations tells a reader to 'Order from the canonical record, fusion-junction-aso-sequences.csv' — a file that reaches them only through that DOI. The paper deliberately offloads its bounds and its ordering instructions to an archive that, at this commit, does not exist publicly. A referee checking the 8/45/3.2/3.0 kcal/mol figures, or a laboratory trying to order a sequence, follows the link and finds nothing.
blockers.artifact: research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-journal-article.md (Data availability), and identically in fusion-junction-aso-journal-article.pdf, -manuscript.pdf, -preprint.pdf, -anonymized.pdf and -manuscript.docx, all of which are built from this exact digest (build stamps verified).
blockers.proposed_replacement: No prose change is warranted and none is proposed: the sentence becomes true when the recorded act lands. The fix is the sequence deposit-state.json already names — (2) refresh deposition 22182180 at the commit being posted, so the deposited manuscript is the one that cites 22182180, then (3) publish it — before the paper is posted anywhere. If the paper is posted before that, the printed identifier must instead be the published record, and the sentence's promise must then be narrowed to what that record actually contains, because 10.5281/zenodo.22180100 carries neither aso_offtarget_duplex_energy.py nor aso-offtarget-duplex-energy.json. NOTE FOR THE DRIVER: this is tracked as open blocking item 3-v in fusion-junction-aso-preprint-checklist.md and is enforced by test_the_deposit_the_papers_cite_is_current.py::test_an_unpublished_version_or_a_drifted_tree_is_openly_tracked. It is graded a blocker because the outgoing text is untrue at the pin, not because it is unknown.

p1s.summary: Nothing reads the DOI printed inside the deposited copy of the manuscript and compares it with the DOI of the deposition that copy is going into. The digest guards prove the draft's manifest is a fact about git history; they say nothing about which identifier the deposited paper points a reader at.
p1s.evidence: research/manuscripts/tests/test_the_deposit_the_papers_cite_is_current.py::test_the_recorded_upload_digest_is_corroborated_by_git_rather_than_declared reads `pending.uploaded_at_git_revision` and asserts only that the manifest AT that revision recorded `pending.uploaded_manifest_digest`; it never opens the manuscript at that revision. test_aso_deposition_doi_is_one_fact.py binds the article's DOI to the WORKING TREE manifest's `deposition_doi`, not to the deposited copy. test_the_preprint_record_reads_the_paper_it_deposits.py governs preprint metadata, not the archive. Measured at the pin: `git show b93499e94401:research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-archive-manifest.json` gives `deposition_doi` 10.5281/zenodo.22180100, and `git show b93499e94401:...journal-article.md | grep -o '10.5281/zenodo.[0-9]*'` returns 10.5281/zenodo.22180100 alone — while `pending.doi` is 22182180. The condition the missing guard would catch is TRUE right now, and every existing deposit guard is green on it.
p1s.what_edit_would_break_it: Any publish of the pending deposition that skips the step-2 refresh — or a future refresh done before, rather than after, the commit that repoints the papers at the next reserved DOI. The mitigation today is one ordered sentence of prose in fusion-junction-aso-preprint-checklist.md ('The refresh is the LAST act before the publish'), which the file itself records as having been got wrong four times on this record.

p2s.summary: The censoring bound and the clean-design count it precedes are measured at different search depths, and the paragraph never says so. Correct at the pin and conservative in direction, but the two numbers describe different populations.
p2s.evidence: I enumerated all 76 committed 16-mer screens at the pin and counted them myself (log s27-referee-censoring.txt). DEFAULT ceiling: 190 design slots, 7 with status screen_failed, 183 screened, 47 whose stored hit list equals the reported near-match count — exactly the paper's 'seven of the 190 alignment screens never returned ... leaving 47 of 183 assessable for cleanliness'. DEEP ceiling (-deep500 / -clean9-deep500): 190 slots, 3 failed, 187 screened, and all 187 lists complete by the same test. The one cleanliness count the paper prints — 'Three designs clear every screen at the ten-base-pair criterion' — is the deep-ceiling result: research/modalities/aso-per-junction-table.json sums to 187 screened and 3 `n_designs_absent_because_the_deep_screen_did_not_return`, and the three (AGGGCATATCGGAGTC at FUS e8, GGGCATATCCGACATG at TAF15 e1, GGGCATATCAAGCGCT at TCF12 e7) are exactly the rows with n_hybridisable == 0 and parent_is_liability false in that file. test_the_numbered_claims_no_instrument_read.py::test_the_cleanliness_bounds_are_the_screens_own_counts pins the four numerals against the default-depth records, so the pairing is the loose part, not the arithmetic; that test's own docstring already notes 'THE DEPTH IS PART OF THE CLAIM, NOT CONTEXT AROUND IT'. Naming the depth in the first bound would close it inside the existing sentence.

p2s.summary: The built PDFs strip every PMID from the reference list, so reference 7 reaches the reader with no persistent identifier at all — it is the one entry with no DOI.
p2s.evidence: fusion-junction-aso-journal-references.md entry 7 reads 'Skorski T, ... Folia Histochem Cytobiol 29:85-89. PMID: 1794439.' with no doi field. Extracted text of fusion-junction-aso-journal-article.pdf at the pin (log s27-referee-article.txt) prints that entry ending '...Folia Histochem Cytobiol 29:85-89.' and contains the string 'PMID' only twice in the whole document, both inside Table 1's caption. Every other entry carries a doi, so entry 7 alone is unresolvable except by journal-volume-page. It is the 1991 anchor of the paper's 'thirty-five-year lineage' claim.

p2s.summary: The two named controls differ in the one chemical feature the paper singles out as a risk: control-1 carries the reagents' 5'-GGG locked G-tract and control-2 does not.
p2s.evidence: research/modalities/aso-control-oligos.json: control-1 = GGGCATCAACATAATC (for GGGCATATCATCAAAC), control-2 = GTATGTCATTGGCTGG (for GGGCATATCTTGTGTG). Both reagents begin GGG, which the manuscript flags: 'Both begin 5'-GGG, a contiguous locked G-tract. High affinity is taken to carry a risk of sequence-dependent hepatotoxicity.' The dinucleotide shuffle preserves length, first and last base, composition and dinucleotide counts — I verified all four for both pairs — and preserving the G-tract is not among them, so nothing in the paper or the table is false. A referee reading the falsification experiment will nonetheless ask why the scrambled control for reagent 2 does not control for the feature the paper names as its chemical liability.

p2s.summary: Declarations sends the reader to fusion-junction-aso-sequences.csv to order, and that file's header block orients them to the OTHER paper — it names the extended report as 'THE PAPER', calls it a preprint, and sources the chemistry from 'SECTION 6 OF THE MANUSCRIPT', a section the journal article does not have.
p2s.evidence: research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-sequences.csv at the pin, header comment block: 'THE PAPER. ... Author: Tristan D. McRae. Manuscript date 2026-08-15 (front matter of fusion-junction-aso-research-article.md). This manuscript is a preprint. It has not been peer reviewed and has not been submitted to a journal.' and 'CHEMISTRY - THE FULL SPECIFICATION, FROM SECTION 6 OF THE MANUSCRIPT.' The journal article's headings are Abstract / Introduction / Materials and Methods / Results / Discussion; it carries no numbered sections. The chemistry specification itself is complete and correct in that file (architecture, phosphorothioate linkage counts by length, beta-D-oxy-LNA bicycle, 5-methylcytosine on locked C and unmethylated dC in the gap, free termini, sodium salt), so a reader CAN act on it; the cross-reference is what does not resolve for the reader the journal article sends.

p2s.summary: The abstract prints the reagents' 'longest wild-type parent gap duplexes eight and nine base pairs' without naming the parent, in a paper whose thesis is that the liability is the design's own parent. Both figures are against wild-type TFG, a gene neither fusion involves.
p2s.evidence: research/modalities/aso-parent-gap-pairing.json per_design: GGGCATATCATCAAAC at EWSR1_e12__NR4A3_e3 -> 8 bp, parent TFG; GGGCATATCTTGTGTG at TAF15_e6__NR4A3_e3 -> 9 bp, parent TFG. The body corrects it one paragraph later ('both against wild-type TFG') and Table 1 prints the gene in the cell, so the exposure is short; it is worth a word in the abstract because the number reads as the own-parent figure the surrounding sentences are about.

p2s.summary: The third design is withheld on a stated selection policy while the paper's own parsimonious reading makes it the design matching the only patient-derived test article on the EWSR1 arm.
p2s.evidence: The paper: 'It is not named for synthesis: this junction is third by reported prevalence and the selection takes the first two.' Two paragraphs later: 'On that reading ... USZ20-EMC1 carries EWSR1 exon 13 joined to exon 3 - the third design named above, not a reagent named for synthesis.' research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-reagent-coverage.json confirms the arithmetic (68.4% -> 79.0%, +10.6 points) and its own `_the_reason_this_field_used_to_give_is_withdrawn` records that the previous reason (no test article) was retired for exactly this. The remaining reason is a policy, not a scientific one, and a referee will ask why it outranks the only patient-derived model that may carry the junction. The paper's hedging of the inference ('an inference and not a determination') is correct and should not be weakened; the question is about the selection rule, not the inference.

leakage: DISCLOSED. One repository-wide `git grep -n "seven of the 190|7 of 190|183 designs|of the 190 alignment" <PIN> -- research` returned lines from four MAY-NOT-READ paths: research/autonomy/review-seats/PUB-ASO-6127da1ac1a2d912b4a9a5f93de6d0f0e98d372c-seat-arithmetic.json (line 81), -seat-hostile-referee.json (line 73), -seat-statistics.json (lines 42 and 56), and research/autonomy/venue-fit.json (line 869). Quantities visible in those lines: (a) an arithmetic seat's claim that at default depth 7 of 190 screens failed with 47 of 183 lists complete, and at the deep ceiling 3 of 190 failed with 36 of 187 uncensored; (b) an earlier hostile-referee finding that a previous draft's 'every panel count below' over-scoped the censoring bound; (c) a statistics seat's geometry evidence (87/190, 88/266, 87/342) and '136 of the 183 filtered designs carry right-censored counts'; (d) a venue-fit summary paragraph restating 87/190 and 61. Prior independence: I had ALREADY derived 187 screened / 3 absent from research/modalities/aso-per-junction-table.json in the immediately preceding tool call, and had already derived 190/87/61/85/38, 45.8/33.1/25.4, the availability ladders, 40.6 vs 45.8, the four sign changes, 8/45/3.2/3.0, 123/8, 156/135, 6-vs-5 loci, 19, union 93, 176, 10.0%/3.9% and 68.4/39.9-82.8/79.0 from research/modalities/** and research/manuscripts/aso/**. Mitigation: every later grep was scoped to research/modalities and research/manuscripts/aso and excluded *-redteam*; the censoring census was then re-derived end to end by enumerating all 76 committed 16-mer screen artifacts and counting statuses and stored-vs-reported hit lists myself (log s27-referee-censoring.txt), which reproduced 7/190, 183, 47 at default depth and 3/190, 187, 187-uncensored at deep depth — note my deep uncensored count (187) DISAGREES with the leaked seat's 36 and I report my own measurement, whose test is stated in the log. No finding in this record is taken from a leaked line; P2a's grade and framing are my own and differ from the leaked hostile-referee finding, which concerned a sentence the pin has already repaired.
